track.title: U.S. Coast Guard Candidate
track.description: Official-source-aware readiness plan covering recruiter contact, eligibility review, ASVAB preparation, MEPS processing, background readiness, fitness, and recruiter packet organization. Verify all requirements with official source and recruiter. Requirements may change.

requirements.title: Contact recruiter / start application process
requirements.description: Initiate official contact with a Coast Guard recruiter as the first step in the GoCoastGuard Get Started process.
requirements.notes: First step per GoCoastGuard Get Started process. Recruiter contact initiates the official application pathway. Verify next steps and timing with your recruiter. Verify with official source and recruiter. Requirements may change.

requirements.title: Confirm baseline eligibility
requirements.description: Review and confirm meeting basic eligibility criteria including citizenship, age range, education credential, and background standing.
requirements.notes: Eligibility criteria include citizenship, age range (typically 17–27 for enlisted), education credential, ASVAB qualifying score, and background review. Waivers are case-by-case through recruiter. Verify current requirements at GoCoastGuard Eligibility page and with your recruiter. Requirements may change.

requirements.title: Complete medical exam / MEPS processing
requirements.description: Complete Military Entrance Processing Station (MEPS) medical examination as a required enlistment processing step.
requirements.notes: MEPS medical exam is a blocking requirement before application readiness. Discuss any medical history items with recruiter prior to MEPS scheduling. Medical waivers are handled case-by-case through recruiter. Verify with official source and recruiter. Requirements may change.

requirements.title: Prepare for ASVAB / qualifying aptitude score
requirements.description: Build preparation for the ASVAB examination and work toward achieving the required Armed Forces Qualification Test (AFQT) score.
requirements.notes: ASVAB qualifying score is required for enlistment. Minimum AFQT score and line score requirements vary by rating. Verify current minimums and required line scores with recruiter before testing. Verify with official source and recruiter. Requirements may change.

requirements.title: Maintain physical fitness readiness
requirements.description: Establish and maintain a physical fitness baseline that supports enlistment processing standards.
requirements.notes: Physical fitness standards are required for enlistment processing. Maintain a consistent conditioning baseline. Verify current physical fitness test (PFT) standards and expectations with recruiter. Requirements may change.

documents.title: Resume / candidate overview
documents.description: Candidate resume and overview for recruiter review. Evidence record — no document contents stored.
documents.notes: Verify recruiter format and content requirements. Verify with official source and recruiter.

documents.title: Identification / legal status record
documents.description: Government-issued ID and citizenship / legal status evidence record for recruiter packet. Record tracks readiness status only — no document contents stored.
documents.notes: Evidence record only — no actual document contents stored here. Verify ID and citizenship documentation requirements with official source and recruiter.

documents.title: Medical prescreen notes
documents.description: Self-prepared medical prescreen notes for recruiter discussion prior to MEPS scheduling. Evidence record only — no medical details stored.
documents.notes: Highest-impact missing document for this track. Discuss medical history items with recruiter before MEPS scheduling. Evidence record only — no medical details stored here. Verify with official source and recruiter.

documents.title: ASVAB prep record / score tracking
documents.description: Tracking record for ASVAB diagnostic results and practice test scores. No actual test scores stored — status tracks readiness progress only.
documents.notes: Use to track study progress and practice test results. Verify ASVAB minimum score requirements with official source and recruiter before testing.

documents.title: Fitness baseline log
documents.description: Fitness baseline log for physical readiness tracking and conditioning reference. Self-maintained evidence record.
documents.notes: Not a formal credentialing document. Used for self-tracking only.
